label: IL PIPA Sec. 10 — Breach notification
body: (a) Any data collector that owns or licenses personal information concerning an Illinois resident shall notify the resident at no charge that there has been a breach … in the most expedient time possible and without unreasonable delay, consistent with any measures necessary to determine the scope of the breach and restore the reasonable integrity, security, and confidentiality of the data system.

(b) A data collector that maintains/stores but does not own/license shall notify the owner or licensee immediately following discovery if the personal information was acquired by an unauthorized person, and cooperate with the owner/licensee.

(e)(2) Any data collector required to issue notice to more than 500 Illinois residents as a result of a single breach shall provide notice to the Attorney General, including: (A) description of the nature of the breach; (B) number of Illinois residents affected; (C) any steps taken or planned.
